bookSourceName: 番茄小说 · 官网公开章节
bookSourceComment: Node.js 原生规则：仅读取官网公开章节，不使用第三方正文服务。付费、锁定、验证页及未知字体映射会明确报错。

ruleBookInfo.name: meta[property='og:novel:book_name']@content
ruleBookInfo.author: meta[property='og:novel:author']@content
ruleBookInfo.tocUrl: <js>var id=baseUrl.match(/\/page\/(\d+)(?:[/?#]|$)/); if(!id)throw new Error('番茄书籍标识缺失'); 'https://fanqienovel.com/api/reader/directory/detail?bookId='+id[1]</js>

ruleContent.content: <js>var state=fqState(result),data=state.reader&&state.reader.chapterData;var id=baseUrl.match(/\/reader\/(\d+)(?:[/?#]|$)/);if(!data||!id||String(data.itemId)!==id[1])throw new Error('番茄章节身份不匹配或正文缺失');if(fqFlag(data.isChapterLock)||fqFlag(data.is_chapter_lock)||fqFlag(data.needPay)||fqFlag(data.need_pay))throw new Error('本章为付费或锁定章节，请在番茄官方客户端阅读');if(typeof data.content!=='string'||!data.content.trim())throw new Error('番茄正文为空，可能需要登录、验证或已下架');java.setContent(data.content);var body=java.getString('body@html').replace(/\n{2,}/g,'\n');if(!body.trim())throw new Error('番茄正文解析为空');fqDecode(body)</js>
